title: Parse before you read
hints: fs.String returns a pointer whose value only changes during fs.Parse. Reading *name before Parse always gives the default.
Build the greeting after Parse. Also check the error Parse returns: with ContinueOnError it reports unknown flags and -h instead of exiting.
errors.Is(err, flag.ErrHelp) means the user asked for help. The usage has already been printed, so return 0. Any other error returns 2.
